text.t:
The beauty of nature meets the magic of Christmas in these delicate baubles made from natural wood slices, laser-engraved with enchanting festive motifs.
You can choose from different designs, such as Father Christmas, the Nutcracker, a snowman, or a delicate little pine tree. Each piece is unique, with its own natural grain, making every decoration even more special.
The delicate gold thread and the small gold bell add a touch of elegance and magic, perfect for bringing your Christmas tree to life.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of young children, who may put it in their mouths.
